column1: # kidnix third-party asset manifest -- machine-readable half of docs/LICENSES.md.
# Everything the image ships that did NOT arrive inside an RPM. RPM content is
# covered by Fedora's own licensing policy and by `%{LICENSE}` on every package
# (tests/image/test_licenses.sh screens those against a denylist); this file is
# for the vendored downloads, where nothing else records provenance.
# AGENTS.md §5: "Bundled content/fonts/voices must be redistributable; record
# licences." docs/LICENSES.md is the prose record a human reads. This is the
# one a test reads, so drift becomes a build failure instead of a surprise.
# Format: TAB-separated, four columns, one row per file.
#   path      absolute path in the image, exactly as installed
#   licence   SPDX identifier where one exists, else a plain-English phrase
#   source    where it came from (the URL a reviewer would check)
#   origin    vendored = downloaded at build time by build_files/
#             first-party = ours, Apache-2.0, lives in system_files/ or shell/
# TO ADD A FILE: add the row here AND the row in docs/LICENSES.md, in the same
# commit as the download. tests/image/test_licenses.sh fails a build where a
# vendored file has no row, a row has no file, or a row is missing from the
# ledger.
# path
